| File | Owns |
| ---- | ---- |

When another document disagrees with those three, **Final wins**.

## How to read the rest of `docs/`

| Area | Files | Role |
| ---- | ----- | ---- |
| Product | `01`–`05`, `09` | Vision, BRD, roles, stories, backlog, business rules |
| Domain | `06`–`08` | Bounded contexts and entities; fields must match Final ERD |
| API narrative | `10. APILists.md` | Grouped catalog; regenerate from OpenAPI when paths conflict |
| Architecture working papers | `11. ArchitectureDesign/01`–`04` | Detail Final consolidates; not a second architecture |
| Engineering | `12. TechnologyDocument/*` | Stack and repo layout **as specified in Final** |
| Delivery | `13. SprintPlanning.md` | Slices across the 8 services |
| Frontend (demo) | `17. FrontendUi.md` | React SPA; not part of Final service map |
| Run locally | `15. LocalDevelopment.md` | Compose topology aligned with Final |
| Runtime contracts | `16. InterServiceContracts.md` | Transfer → Wallet → Ledger REST; Kafka for side effects |

## Money model (from Final)

- **Wallet DB:** snapshot `available_balance`, `reserved_balance`, optimistic `version`.
- **Ledger DB:** immutable double-entry; system of record for accounting.
- **Transfer path:** synchronous REST (Wallet, then Ledger). **Kafka** publishes facts for notification, audit, and risk — it does not post ledger entries.
